def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Complete the checkerboard pattern indicated by the two colors on opposite checkerboard parities.
    vals={grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]}
    if len(vals)==2:
        a=next(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] and (r+c)%2==0)
        b=next(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] and (r+c)%2==1)
        return [[a if (r+c)%2==0 else b for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    return grid
out=transform([[9,3],[0,9]])
